exactTags: v-prefixed exact tags are immutable release records.
floatingTags: vX, vX-alpha, vX.Y, and vX.Y-alpha are channel pointers updated by Buildchain transactions; vX-alpha follows the highest minor in major X with a published alpha.

githubRelease.authoritativeIntent: Buildchain publication channel controls prerelease/latest metadata when available
githubRelease.alphaChannel: alpha publication sets prerelease=true and make_latest=false
githubRelease.stableChannels: release, stable, and major publication set prerelease=false and make_latest=true
githubRelease.tagFallback: ordinary callers without publication intent use semver prerelease syntax

homebrewTap.sourceOfTruth: upstream release passport and sibling evidence
